title: Heart Rate Variability processing
summary: A classification pipeline over heart-rate-variability signals for predicting risky cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events, accompanying a 2025 deep-learning paper. Its training data is enlarged by SDV: `src/data/generate_synthetic.py` describes the feature table with `SingleTableMetadata`, fits a `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` and checks the result with `evaluate_quality`, and `src/models/transfer_model.py` imports the same pair to pretrain on synthetic rows before transferring to the real cohort, with `sdv~=1.8.0` pinned. SDV's copula synthesizer is run as the augmentation step the transfer model depends on.

title: patectsdgym
summary: A refactor and extension of PATE-CTGAN with an evaluation suite based on OpenDP's DPSDGym, adding a Wasserstein loss and DRAGAN regularisation to produce WPATECTDRAGAN. Every architecture it ships is built from CTGAN: `dpctgan.py` declares `class DPCTGAN(CTGANSynthesizer)` and says so in its docstring, `patectgan.py` does the same, and `architectures/ctgan.py` assembles a model from CTGAN's `ConditionalGenerator`, `Discriminator`, `Generator`, `Sampler` and `DataTransformer`. CTGAN's classes are subclassed and recombined into differentially private variants.

title: Fraudulent transaction prediction in Bitcoin networks
summary: A machine-learning course project on the Elliptic Bitcoin dataset, trying to improve on the published results for classifying illicit transactions. One of its approaches is a whole script named for the model: `ctgan.py` imports `ctgan` and fits `ctgan.CTGANSynthesizer` to expand the heavily imbalanced illicit class. CTGAN is called as one of the project's rebalancing techniques.

title: Southlake agentic synthetic data studio
summary: A hackathon prototype that turns a curated emergency-department public-use dataset into synthetic planning data, evaluation reports and pitch artifacts, driven by LLM agents. SDV is the generator underneath: `services/synth-api/app/pipeline.py` builds a `SingleTableMetadata` and fits a `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` with `sdv==1.34.3` pinned, falling back to bootstrap resampling if the library is unavailable, and the pitch deck devotes a technical explainer and a judge-QA answer to how the copula model works. SDV's copula synthesizer is run as the studio's synthesis engine.

title: DP-HP
summary: Code for 'Hermite Polynomial Features for Private Data Generation' (ICML 2022), which uses Hermite feature maps to match distributions under differential privacy. Its tabular experiments are loaded through SDGym: `data/tab_dataloader.py` imports `sdgym` for the benchmark datasets, with the older `sdgym.datasets.load_tables` path left commented beside it. SDGym is called as the benchmark-dataset harness the DP experiments run on.

title: Synthetic tabular healthcare data with GANs
summary: A thesis assessing TGAN, CTGAN, CTAB-GAN and WGAN-GP on healthcare tables of varying size, motivated by HIPAA and GDPR barriers to sharing patient records. It carries three SDV-family repositories in-tree rather than installing them: `tabular_gan_models/CTGAN/` holds CTGAN with RDT bundled inside it, and `evaluation/sdv/` and `evaluation/sdmetrics/` hold SDV and SDMetrics, which the evaluation notebook drives. SDV, SDMetrics and RDT are vendored wholesale as the study's generator and its scorecard.

title: GAN for software fault prediction
summary: Nine oversampling techniques compared for software fault prediction, one script each — WGAN-GP, SMOTE, ADASYN and others — on imbalanced defect datasets. CTGAN's source is vendored and run as one of nine compared rebalancing methods.

title: privgem

Its whole tabular half descends from CTGAN: `privgem/tabular/ctgan.py` declares `class ctgan(CTGANSynthesizer)` and `privgem/tabular/dpctgan.py` declares `class dpctgan(CTGANSynthesizer)` assembled from CTGAN's `DataTransformer` and `ConditionalGenerator`, and the package installs `ctgan` from the author's own fork, `kasra-hosseini/CTGAN@privgem_develop`, alongside `sdv<0.13`. title: FDR under dependencies
summary: Code for a preprint showing that in omics datasets with highly correlated features, false-discovery-rate corrections such as Benjamini-Hochberg can report thousands of false positives while remaining inside their formal guarantees. The demonstration needs null data that keeps the real correlation structure, and SDV makes it: `synthetic_null_data_generation.ipynb` fits a `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` over an `sdv.metadata.Metadata`, with `sdv~=1.18.0` pinned. SDV's copula synthesizer is run to manufacture the correlated null datasets the whole result rests on.

title: synloc
summary: synloc, a published algorithm and package that creates synthetic tabular data by fitting local distributions around nearest-neighbour clusters rather than one global model. It sits on the copula stack and is measured against SDV: the package depends on `copulas` and uses `GaussianMultivariate` and `VineCopula` from `copulas.multivariate`, while the replication notebooks fit `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer`, `CTGANSynthesizer` and `TVAESynthesizer` (and the older `sdv.lite.TabularPreset`) as the comparison set and score everything with `KSComplement` and `CorrelationSimilarity` from `sdv.metrics.tabular`.
